classes.browser: the scenario needs an interactive browser session (typing, clicking, a panel that updates); the page tools themselves are checked by the browser lane of tests/e2e/
classes.drift: the scenario text asks for a command, flag, path, argument or output that the current specification does not define or defines differently; the feature text needs updating before the scenario can run as written
classes.external: the scenario needs a third-party service or application (the w3id redirect service, an Obsidian install, a Zenodo deposit)
classes.forge: the scenario needs a forge or a hosting platform (a pull request, a workflow run, a deploy, an issue, a release)
classes.gap: a rule requires the behaviour and the reference engine does not implement it yet
classes.model: the scenario runs an agent lane for real, which needs a model adapter and a channel adapter; the reference engine ships neither and implements only refresh --dry-run

persona-0-dropin.feature#Publishing the.reason: pushing the repository and Cloudflare Pages serving www/ at a domain happen on the forge and the host, not in the engine.

persona-0-dropin.feature#Three commands.reason: 'the build succeeds offline with warnings only' cannot hold under the current rules: ci refuses a node with no authored .well-known/security.txt (AGSC-06-36, AGSC-E901), with the Content Use Terms and no site.tdm_crawlers (AGSC-06-18, AGSC-E202), and every reference AGSC-E507 reports is also an unresolved body reference (AGSC-03-11, AGSC-E310 error); AGSC-02-92 and AGSC-02-95 say the opposite. Recorded as a specification item.

persona-a-reader.feature#Home page state.reason: no rule requires the home page to show an install line, a counts line or links to /graph.jsonld and /llms.txt, and the engine's home page shows none of them; the discovery link is the header of AGSC-06-17.

persona-a-reader.feature#Reader inspects.reason: no rule groups a cluster page's members by sub-cluster and the engine lists them flat; the NOW half (build time, counts, stale items, open lessons) is covered by the ledger and refresh tests.

persona-a-reader.feature#Reader opens a.reason: the item schema defines the optional keys evidence and maturity, but no rule asks the page to show them as facet chips and the engine shows neither; no rule defines a 'family › deck › subdeck' breadcrumb or typed Links with inverses on the page; diagram sources are content/diagrams/<slug>.diagram, as the scenario says, but the footer offers 'Machine views: Markdown · JSON-LD' and 'Propose an edit', not the quoted words.

persona-a-reader.feature#Reader searches.reason: typing into the search box and watching the requests the page makes needs a browser; the index itself (/search.json, AGSC-06-16) is checked by the unit tests.

persona-b-contributor.feature#CI runs a.reason: no rule defines 'lint L1 and L2 findings' or PR annotations, and the engine prints none; the double build and the absence of a model call are checked by the persona-k scenario that runs and by the ci tests.

persona-b-contributor.feature#Contributo.reason: the commit trailer and the pull-request body are written by the contributor on the forge; the marker propose writes is checked by the persona-d acceptance test.
the engine links GitHub's edit view at /edit/HEAD/<path> (the default branch, whatever its name), not /edit/main/<path>; opening the link and GitHub's fork flow need a browser and the forge.

persona-b-contributor.feature#Maintainer.reason: approval, the branch ruleset, the merge and the Cloudflare deploy happen on the forge and the host.

persona-c-agent-mcp.feature#Agent calls.reason: search takes 'query' (not 'q') and no 'limit'; links takes 'slug' or 'iri' and no 'type' filter (the tool manifest of AGSC-09-13/09-16).

persona-c-agent-mcp.feature#Agent starts.reason: mcp takes an optional Bundle path (AGSC-09-09); there is no --site flag, and 'claude mcp add' is a third-party command. The seven tools are checked by the scenario on memory that runs.

persona-c-agent-mcp.feature#Agent uses t.reason: 'remember with kind episode, a title and a body' is refused at rc.6: an episode needs the declared actor and the instant 'at' (AGSC-09-14b), and a conforming episode also needs prov.operator from the client; the ask half is pinned by vector cli-0007.

persona-c-agent-mcp.feature#Non-MCP agen.reason: /llms.txt lists each item's page URL (AGSC-06-13), not a /pages/<slug>.md link; the per-item Markdown exists and graph.ttl is checked for blank nodes by the graph vectors.

persona-c-agent-mcp.feature#Server cache.reason: the 1.0 server reads a local Bundle; no rule defines a remote client mode that fetches exports and caches them under $XDG_CACHE_HOME, and the engine has none.

persona-d-agent-proposer.feature#Agent n.reason: propose takes a slug and no --title or --rationale flag (AGSC-09-09); the real flow, lint --fix and propose <slug>, is covered by the persona-d acceptance test.

persona-d-agent-proposer.feature#Fork-or.reason: the open-bot-PR cap and fork secrets are forge workflow behaviour.

persona-d-agent-proposer.feature#Operato.reason: running the printed git and gh commands opens a pull request on the forge.

persona-e-architect.feature#Architect na.reason: naming the Harness and clicking Download needs a browser; the Harness file set is covered by the compose and harness tests.

persona-e-architect.feature#Browser outp.reason: the Background names www/js/agsc-core.js, which the engine does not emit (the module is www/compose/agsc-core.js); the byte identity of the browser module and the command line is covered by tests/composition/browser.test.js.

persona-e-architect.feature#Excludes mut.reason: the panel's messages need a browser; the closure algebra behind them is covered by the compose vectors.

persona-e-architect.feature#Selecting Co.reason: ticking a Concept and reading the panel needs a browser; the compose page loads www/compose/agsc-core.js, not www/js/agsc-core.js as the Background says.

persona-f-integrator.feature#Each instal.reason: installed packs are named <cluster>/SKILL.md, not agsc-<cluster>/SKILL.md, and the Background's '20 packs' is a count of one site's clusters.

persona-f-integrator.feature#Installed p.reason: lint reads a Bundle, not an installed skill tree; the content-only and lockfile checks run inside skills install and are covered by tests/composition/skills.test.js.

persona-f-integrator.feature#Integrator.reason: skills install takes a local target directory (AGSC-07-21) and no --into flag, and it installs from the local build, not from a site URL, which would need the network.

persona-f-integrator.feature#Integrator'.reason: skills import takes one SKILL.md file, not a directory (AGSC-07-22).

persona-g-team.feature#A Gate's checks c.reason: the Background runs 'init my-specs --host none', which init refuses with AGSC-E002; and ci, not build, compiles the checks (AGSC-08-12).

persona-g-team.feature#Team authors Mode.reason: the Background runs 'init my-specs --host none'; init takes no argument and no flag (AGSC-09-09), so the command is refused with AGSC-E002.

persona-g-team.feature#Team exports stee.reason: the Background runs 'init my-specs --host none', which init refuses with AGSC-E002 (AGSC-09-09).

persona-g-team.feature#Team publishes it.reason: the Background runs 'init my-specs --host none', which init refuses with AGSC-E002; and /specs/ is the namespace site's route, which the engine does not generate (AGSC-06-01).

persona-h-memory.feature#Agent exports t.reason: export writes under dist/export/<form>/ and takes no output directory argument (AGSC-01-26…27), so './out' is not where the files land.

persona-h-memory.feature#Agent imports a.reason: import requires --from <adapter> (AGSC-01-22); without it the command is refused with AGSC-E003.

persona-h-memory.feature#Exported Markdo.reason: opening a folder as an Obsidian vault needs the Obsidian application.

persona-i-maintainer.feature#Local ci an.reason: AGSC-08-10 requires a gate verdict in dist/gate.json and the engine never writes it; the scenario also needs the forge for the ci.yml half.

persona-i-maintainer.feature#Restore-fro.reason: comparing with the last published deploy and the weekly attested snapshot and Zenodo deposit needs the host and Zenodo; the byte-identical rebuild itself is the ci double build.

persona-i-maintainer.feature#The maintai.reason: pushing a tag, trusted publishing and provenance attestations happen on the forge and the registry.

persona-i-maintainer.feature#The weekly.reason: the cron trigger and 'gh issue create' are forge behaviour; the stale-items list of the NOW page is checked by the unit tests.

persona-j-standards.feature#Implementer.reason: the 303 redirects are served by the w3id service from its .htaccess, which runs on w3id's host.
a content node omits rel#ontology (AGSC-06-10 as stated at rc.6), links rel#graph to /graph.nq and /graph.ttl rather than /graph.jsonld, and publishes /specs/ only on the namespace site.

persona-k-live-board.feature#A planner c.reason: 'worker opens a Proposal that creates 21 task concepts' is a model-driven lane run; the max_new_items cap is covered by the governance tests.

persona-k-live-board.feature#An agent cl.reason: 'refresh --agent worker' without --dry-run opens a real Proposal through a model and a channel, which the reference engine does not ship.

persona-k-live-board.feature#The agent l.reason: 'the agent opens a Proposal' is a model-driven lane run; the AGSC-E509 gate itself is covered by tests/governance/agents tests and refresh --dry-run.

persona-k-live-board.feature#The board r.reason: the second half runs 'refresh --agent worker' without --dry-run, which needs a model adapter.

persona-k-live-board.feature#The budget.reason: 'refresh --agent worker' without --dry-run needs a model adapter; the budget meter (AGSC-E510) is covered by the NOW spend tests.

persona-k-live-board.feature#The build s.reason: the Background says agsc.config.json 'declares the surface mcp', but mcp is a derived surface that surfaces[] never lists (config schema, AGSC-11-16) and its target /specs/mcp/ is the namespace site's; the double build and the model-free lanes are covered by the ci tests and tests/arch/.

persona-k-live-board.feature#The node-wi.reason: 'refresh --agent worker' without --dry-run needs a model adapter; the override-name line of ci and AGSC-E403 are covered by the ci and secrets tests.

persona-k-live-board.feature#The work-in.reason: 'worker proposes' is a model-driven lane run; the AGSC-E511 claim cap is covered by the governance tests.
